flashcard_questions.q: What was the aim of the Favela Bairro project in Rio?
flashcard_questions.a: To improve living conditions in the favelas rather than demolish them.

flashcard_questions.q: What does a site and service scheme provide for residents?
flashcard_questions.a: Land and basic infrastructure on which they can build.

flashcard_questions.q: How many free cable car journeys did each Complexo do Alemão resident get?
Why did the Complexo do Alemão cable car close in 2016?
flashcard_questions.a: There was no funding left to maintain it.

flashcard_questions.q: What budget did the Favela Bairro scheme have?
How many favelas does Rio contain?
What do self-help schemes give residents so they can improve their homes?
flashcard_questions.a: Low-interest loans plus the tools and training to do the work.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can self-help schemes still push the poorest residents out?
flashcard_questions.a: Some must buy the improved house or pay rent they cannot afford.

flashcard_questions.q: What were Pacifying Police Units set up to do in Rio?
flashcard_questions.a: Patrol the favelas and make them safer from armed drug gangs.

flashcard_questions.q: How many favelas did the Pacifying Police Units reclaim from drug gangs?
Why has the long-term success of the Pacifying Police Units been limited?
flashcard_questions.a: Drug gangs have reclaimed much of the territory the units took back.
Meeting today's needs without compromising the needs of future generations.

flashcard_questions.q: How long is Curitiba's network of dedicated bus lanes?
What share of Curitiba's waste is recycled?
Which reward lets Green Exchange residents travel to better-paid jobs?

notes: 15 cards: 4 term-to-definition (Favela Bairro aim, site and service, sustainability, UPP purpose), 5 case-study-to-fact with one figure each ($1 billion, over 1,000 favelas, 30 favelas reclaimed, 72 km, two-thirds recycled), 4 cause-to-consequence (cable car closure, self-help displacement, UPP limitation, Green Exchange mobility), 2 strategy-to-example (self-help provision, free cable car trip allowance). Dropped the 28-parks and 200-copycat-cities figures to keep the Curitiba half from outweighing the Favela Bairro case study.
